title: MCP Tool Descriptor
description: Describes a platform capability exposed as an MCP tool through the shared MCP gateway. Binds the tool to its owning capability and declares the authorization and audit it inherits, so every agent-invocable surface is governed identically to the human/system surfaces. The gateway enforces authorization.required_action via the authorization capability and emits an audit-event when audited=true.

capability_id.description: Owning capability id in the registry (e.g. 'approval', 'audit').

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool arguments (the capability's request contract).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool result.

authorization.description: AuthZ the gateway enforces before invoking (delegates to the authorization capability).

required_action.description: authorize() action checked for the calling principal.

audited.description: If true, every invocation emits an audit-event (default true).

side_effecting.description: True for tools that mutate state (gateway may require HITL/approval).
